cohort: Monochorionic twin pregnancies with preterm birth (24-37 weeks of gestation) between November 2003 and December 2016
finding: Spontaneous TAPS, diagnosed postnatally, was not associated with an increased risk of adverse neonatal and neurodevelopmental outcomes in this cohort.
mod_finding: While the study found that the spontaneous TAPS group had a higher risk for cesarean delivery, it primarily focuses on neonatal and neurodevelopmental outcomes and does not draw conclusions specifically about mode of delivery.
